Regression Weight Interpretation Table (Flextable)

create_regwt_interp_ft.Rd

Creates a flextable with one row per predictor showing the regression weight (b) interpretation. Auto-generates interpretations or uses custom-provided ones. Answer key uses red text.

Usage

create_regwt_interp_ft(reg_results_list, interpretations = NULL, KEY = TRUE)

Arguments

reg_results_list

Output from regression_answers().

interpretations

Named list or NULL. Custom interpretations keyed by predictor variable name. If NULL, auto-generated.

KEY

Logical. If TRUE (default), show filled interpretations (red text). If FALSE, blank cells.

Value

A flextable object.

Examples

data(superman)
sm <- superman[!is.na(superman$rt_critics_score) &
                    !is.na(superman$rt_audience_score), ]
result <- regression_answers(
  data = sm,
  criterion = "rt_critics_score",
  quant_predictors = c("clark_height_in", "rt_audience_score"),
  quant_labels = c("Height", "Audience"),
  criterion_label = "Critics Score"
)
create_regwt_interp_ft(result, KEY = TRUE)

Predictor
Interpretation
Height
Height does not contribute to the model
Audience
Audience does not contribute to the model
create_regwt_interp_ft(result, KEY = FALSE)

Predictor
Interpretation
Height
Audience
